setting.help: Controls whether the cashier must specify raw materials for manufactured products before completing a POS order.

How far the raw material total may differ from the quantity sold, in the finished product's unit (0.1 = 100 g for products sold by the kilo). Over the tolerance the order is blocked; under it the cashier is warned but may continue. Skipped when the units are not convertible.
Whether a POS refund that affects a Manufacturing Order raises a To-Do activity. Choose Always to also get one for refunds handled automatically. Every action is written to the chatter regardless.
User who receives the To-Do activity. Falls back to the Manufacturing Order's responsible, then to the cashier, if left empty.
